item.description: Diesel prices are soaring, pushing Vermont loggers to the brink. Rising fuel costs add to struggles from mill closures and equipment expenses. The future of Vermont's logging industry is at risk.

Two people were arrested in Rutland City in a fentanyl trafficking case. Police seized nearly twelve grams of suspected fentanyl at Sheldon Towers. Authorities urge anyone with information to contact Rutland City police.

One million dollars in funding is now available to dairy farmers in the Northeast. Farmers in New York, Vermont, and New Hampshire can apply for modernization grants. This program covers eleven states to support farm improvements.

The Adirondack region is alive with Halloween events this week. From plays and poetry readings to parades and trunk-or-treats, towns like Tupper Lake, Lake Placid, and Schroon Lake are hosting family-friendly festivities. These activities celebrate community spirit and the spooky season across the North Country.
